easy.def: All of a person or animal, from head to foot.
examples: My body is strong.
Wash your body.
A bird has a small body.

more.def: The whole physical form of a person or animal, including the head, arms, and legs.
examples: Exercise helps keep your body healthy.
The giraffe has a long neck and a small body.
She wrapped a towel around her body after swimming.

easy.def: Pages with words or pictures that you read.
examples: I read a book.
She has a new book.
This book is funny.

more.def: A set of pages with words or pictures that are joined together in a cover.
examples: I borrowed a book about space from the library.
My favorite book has a green cover and a hundred pages.
This book has a story about a dragon.

easy.def: To use something that is not yours and then give it back.
examples: Can I borrow your red crayon?
I borrow books from my friend.
May I borrow your pencil?

more.def: To take and use something that belongs to someone else, planning to return it.
examples: She borrowed three books from the library and returned them on Friday.
He borrowed his dad's umbrella because it was raining.
You can borrow a board game from the classroom shelf.
I like both.
Both are good.
Hold it with both hands.

more.def: The one and the other of two people or things.
examples: Both of my brothers play the guitar.
I tried the red and the blue shirts, and I like both.
Both teams ran onto the field at the same time.

easy.def: A line that shows where a place ends.
examples: The fence is the boundary of our yard.
The white line is the boundary of the field.
A wall marks the boundary of the farm.

more.def: A line or edge that marks where one area ends and another begins.
examples: The river forms the boundary between the two countries.
The ball rolled past the boundary, so play stopped.
Mountains form a natural boundary between the two valleys.
The boy is my brother.
A boy kicked the ball.
That boy is in my class.

more.def: A male child or young man.
examples: The boy on the bus gave his seat to an older lady.
A group of boys was building a sandcastle at the beach.
He was a curious boy who asked questions about everything.
